system.description:
Your body is both ward and wire—a walking firewall etched in runes and circuitry. Requirement: You have at least one Arcana card and one Circuit card in your active loadout.

Effect: As a Reaction, once per Scene, You have Resistance to magic damage. In addition, when you would take damage from ICE (digital countermeasures), you may mark 1 Armor Slot to reduce that damage as normal (treat it as a physical hit for purposes of Armor).
